title: Hogwarts Legacy
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball Failure report with a crash dump from WaterWANG-1014 (highball-db#48, 2026-09-15).
notes: DirectX 12, so D3DMetal, and heavy. Under investigation with an M4 Max on macOS 15.7.7 (highball-db#48). The crash seconds after launch turned out to be the game refusing two graphics API flags on its command line (-dx11 plus a second one), measured from its crash context, so keep at most one such flag in the Steam launch options. On D3DMetal without -dx11 the game runs about 30 seconds then reports "Failed to initialize DirectX 12", cause not measured. CrossOver 26 users report the game running on this D3DMetal on macOS 15, so a working configuration exists. DXMT and DXVK cannot run the DirectX 12 build.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at second zero at fixed addresses on any graphics mode when -dx11 is among the Steam launch options (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: measured from CrashContext.runtime-xml: "-d3d12, -d3d11, -vulkan, and -opengl are mutually exclusive options, but more than one was specified on the command-line". The game got two graphics API flags. Highball and this row add none, the source of the second flag is being traced
knownIssues.fix: one graphics API flag at most in the Steam launch options. AVX advertised to the game turned out unrelated, the runs that got past this crash were the runs without -dx11

knownIssues.symptom: "Failed to initialize DirectX 12. Graphics drivers may require an update" after about 30 seconds on D3DMetal with AVX on (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: not measured. Not a macOS 26 requirement, CrossOver 26 ships the same D3DMetal 3.0 on macOS 15 and the game is reported running there
knownIssues.fix: none yet, waiting on the game's log lines from the D3D12 RHI
